newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline weaker as NYMEX falls, buyers relaxed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline weaker as NYMEX falls, buyers relaxed.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker on Tuesday as sluggish demand and falling futures combined to pressure prices.
Barge trade was quiet, with buyers relaxed as they watched NYMEX unleaded futures tumble by over 1.5 cents a gallon, or nearly $6 a tonne by late afternoon.
Nov swaps traded some $5 lower at $224 and $224.50 fob ARA.

Traders said that despite the fall on NYMEX, the U.S. arb was workable, particularly for well-supplied regular unleaded product. A vessel was seen fixed from the U.K. to the U.S. for Nov 3. --Rosalind Russell, London newsroom +44 171 542 5387
